name: Azami
source:
The Fourth-Ranked School Youkai. The elder sister of Sumire, she commands the growth of magical thistles. Azami uses her honeyed words to draw in prey.

[SPOILER]The magical thistles are only visible to those who are being bullied. If they eat one of those thistles, they will become a bully themselves.

Her honeyed words are a terrifying hypocritical technique. Her ladylike manner of dressings draws in bullied children and makes them think she's some goddess who has come to save them. Apparently, there was once a time when she would take on a human guise and became an incredibly bad bully herself.[/SPOILER]

[Based on her unlockable character profile.]
